item.title: The most underrated quarterback in the NFL is the one on your team
item.description: Last month, The Athletic released Mike Sando’s Quarterback Tiers — the definitive annual survey assessing NFL quarterbacks, according to a panel of NFL coaches, executives and other insiders. Quarterback Tiers has been going strong for more than a decade. But this year, we tried something new: We invited readers to weigh in, too, by giving them an option to place quarterbacks in the tier where they thought they belonged, ranging from Tier 1 (elite, franchise quarterbacks) to Tier 5 (not an NFL starter). In all, more than 45,000 readers cast more than half a million votes. In general,...
